title: InterMesh Participant Configuration
description: Per-participant local receiver configuration. The raw token is intentionally stored separately in the local token file, not in this JSON config.

room_id.description: Primary room for simple clients. Must also appear in room_ids when present.

room_ids.description: Rooms the participant expects this token to be scoped for. Server-side token scope remains authoritative.

team_id.description: Optional local display hint for the participant team. Server-side token data remains authoritative.

event_slug.description: Optional event slug hint extracted from the room id.

table_id.description: Optional table id hint extracted from the room id.

topic_id.description: Optional topic id hint extracted from the room id.

jot_url.description: Optional Jot or shared workspace URL associated with the room.

participant_role.description: Local role hint for the participant.

tmux_socket.description: Optional tmux socket path for pane dispatch targets.

targets.description: Optional mapping from remote identity to local dispatch target. When absent, delivered frames are logged to the inbound ledger only.

tmux_session.description: Local tmux target session/window/pane passed to tmux send-keys.

default_target.description: Reserved future local dispatch target. Current v1 receiver reports readiness when present but dispatches through explicit targets.
